description: A shell script that contains a diagram of commit relationships and a series of tests for git log and merge behaviors, focusing on 'TREESAME' and history limiting features.

methods.name: note
methods.description: Tags a git commit with a given label.

methods.name: unnote
methods.description: Processes git name-rev output to remove tags and annotations.

methods.name: check_outcome
methods.description: Runs git log with specified format and compares output to expected.

methods.name: check_result
methods.description: Wrapper to check successful git log output for given parameters.
